closing: Pick one up before touching the repo — `moai mv <id> in_progress --from todo`

Found something outside what you hold? Ask first — can this epic deliver what it promised without it? If not it is a member: same epic (`-e`) or a child (`--parent`). Only otherwise `moai backlog add`. Leaving it unwritten is the worst
A review is an issue too — raise one before `/code-review`. `-b` says what you are looking at and `-m` closes it; without either the write is refused
Leave the AI that did the work — `moai note <id> 'model: <vendor>/<model> tokens=<n> (<grade> — <why>)'`
Closing while still holding it? Leave the next session a line — `moai note <id> 'next: …'`
Run `moai status` once more and see the warnings did not grow

commands.said: what you can pick up now
body, children, history — why it was decided that way
pick it up (only while the column still stands)
a note the next session reads
park what is not for now
